title: The Essential Vibes Tour
lessons: The player realizes CELSIUS is presenting sponsor of the whole festival, part of a multi-year deal covering every Breakaway stop.
The player already knows CELSIUS and now recognizes new Vibe cans as flavor-led reasons to keep browsing the lineup.

text: The main stage has a sponsor banner. So do the wristbands. So does the water refill station. It's the same name every time.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Your name is on the main stage, the wristbands, and I think the porta-potties.

entry-first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Presenting sponsor! Every Breakaway stop, all ten, more than one year. They even named the whole run after me: the Essential Vibes Tour.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: So you didn't just buy an ad. You bought the night.

entry-first-4.speaker: CELSIUS
text: I bought the night. Look around. Everybody here is up way past when they meant to be. That's my crowd. I didn't have to convince anyone.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: That's a very long-term commitment for one crowd.

entry-first-6.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Multi-year, ten cities. I didn't want to be a booth. Booths get walked past. I wanted my name on the thing you say when you tell people where you were.

choice-first.speaker: CELSIUS
text: You've got that look. Say it before the next set starts.

choices.text: Honestly, this is exactly the room you belong in.
Buying the whole tour name is a big spend to look this effortless.
I'd rather the festival exist without a sponsor's name stapled to it.

first-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Told you. This isn't me crashing the party. This is the party.

first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yeah, it's a lot of money. Ten stops, a name on everything. None of it's an accident and I'm not going to pretend it was cheap.

first-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Somebody's paying for the stage either way. At least you know it's me. I'm the only sponsor here who'll admit it to your face.
The cooler by the side stage has four cans you haven't seen before: Galaxy, Arctic, Tropical, Retro. All Vibe. All CELSIUS.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Galaxy. Arctic. Tropical. Retro. Are these flavors or moods?

entry-return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yes.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: That was not one of the options.

entry-return-4.speaker: CELSIUS
text: The energy part doesn't change. The names are so the cooler never feels finished. If it looks finished, you stop looking.

choice-return.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Pick one. Don't think. Go.

choices.text: I like picking a flavor that fits the mood.
The names are doing more work than whatever's different inside.
I don't need twenty-nine ways to buy the same energy habit.

return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Pick one. Commit to the bit.

return-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Arctic.

return-1-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Correct answer emotionally. Not nutritionally.

return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yeah. Most of the time it's the name and the can. The stuff inside is basically me in a different outfit. I'm not sorry, the outfits are good.

return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then grab one or stop browsing. Twenty-nine is only fun if you're having fun.
